# Test 14: Enum with class bodies (enum_body) and guarded pattern
# Direction has constants NORTH, SOUTH, EAST, WEST with class bodies.
# SOUTH is matched via guarded pattern (should not count) and also
# via an unguarded pattern (should count).
# Expected: exhaustive

TYPES
enum_body Direction NORTH SOUTH EAST WEST

SWITCHES
switch s1 Direction
enum Direction.NORTH
guarded_enum Direction.SOUTH
enum Direction.SOUTH
enum Direction.EAST
enum Direction.WEST
end
